```java
public static double calculateProbability(int n) {
    double probability = 1.0 / (double) n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        probability *= 1.0 - (double) i / (double) (n - 1);
    }
    return probability;
}
```
The function starts with an initial probability of 1.0 divided by the number of passengers. It then iterates over each passenger, calculating the probability that they will not sit in their own seat. This is done by multiplying the current probability by the probability that the previous passenger will not sit in their own seat.

For example, if there are 2 passengers, the calculation would be:
```
P(last passenger sits in their own seat) = 1.0 / 2
P(not last passenger sits in their own seat) = 1.0 / 1
P(last passenger sits in their own seat | not last passenger sits in their own seat) = 1.0 / 1

Probability: 1.0 / 2 \* 1.0 / 1 = 0.5
```
For a total of 3 passengers, the calculation would be:
```
P(last passenger sits in their own seat) = 1.0 / 3
P(not last passenger sits in their own seat) = 1.0 / 2
P(last passenger sits in their own seat | not last passenger sits in their own seat) = 1.0 / 2

Probability: 1.0 / 3 \* 1.0 / 2 \* 1.0 / 2 = 1.0 / 3 \* 1.0 / 2 = 1.0 / 6
```
This is repeated for all possible number of passengers, and the final result is the probability that the last passenger will sit in their own seat.

```
public static int findNthUglyNumber(int n) {
    if (n <= 0) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("n must be positive");
    }
    int[] factors = {2, 3, 5};
    int[] products = new int[n];
    products[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int minProduct = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (int factor : factors) {
            if (products[i - 1] == factor * factors[i - 1]) {
                break;
            }
            minProduct = Math.min(minProduct, products[i - 1] * factor);
        }
        products[i] = minProduct;
        for (int factor : factors) {
            if (products[i] == factor * factors[i]) {
                factors[i]++;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return products[n - 1];
}
```
